name: flowtherapy-designer
description: FT Designer : composition de publications multi-formats, entièrement décrites en YAML.

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @ftd/server & npm run dev -w @ftd/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ftd/web && npm run build:atelier
scripts.build:demo: npx -w @ftd/server tsx scripts/build-demo-data.ts && VITE_DEMO=1 npm run build -w @ftd/web
scripts.build:atelier: npm run library:atelier && npm run build -w @ftd/atelier
